title: Functional Principal Component Analysis: Minimax Optimality from Sparse to Dense Designs and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2611.24228v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Functional principal component analysis (FPCA) plays a central role as a dimension-reduction and representation tool in functional data analysis, but its minimax theory for diverging spectral indices under noisy discrete observation has remained open for over two decades. To fill this gap, we consider a sieve-based FPCA framework that pools discrete measurements across subjects and accommodates sampling frequencies ranging from sparse to dense under random designs. We begin by establishing new minimax rates for covariance estimation over general bivariate function classes beyond tensor-product low-complexity structures, thereby identifying the intrinsically two-dimensional optimal rate. Our central theoretical contribution is to establish minimax optimal rates for both individually labelled eigenfunctions with diverging indices and leading principal subspaces of increasing dimensions, under explicit growth and regularity conditions. translated_title: 函数主成分分析：从稀疏到稠密设计及更广泛情形的极小化极大最优性
translated_abstract: 函数主成分分析（FPCA）作为函数数据分析中的降维与表示工具发挥着核心作用，但其在含噪离散观测下谱指标发散情形的极小化极大理论二十多年来一直悬而未决。为填补这一空白，我们考虑了一种基于筛（sieve）的FPCA框架，该框架汇集跨个体的离散测量数据，并能适应随机设计下从稀疏到稠密的各种采样频率。我们首先在超越张量积低复杂度结构的一般二元函数类上建立了协方差估计的新极小化极大速率，从而识别出本质上二维的最优速率。我们的核心理论贡献是在明确的增长与正则性条件下，为具有发散指标的逐一标记的特征函数以及维数不断增加的领先主子空间建立了极小化极大最优速率。
tldr: 本文首次在含噪离散观测下建立了函数主成分分析的完整极小化极大最优理论，覆盖了从稀疏到稠密随机设计中谱指标发散的特征函数与维数递增的主子空间，并给出了一般二元函数类上本质上二维的最优协方差估计速率。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the first complete minimax optimal theory for FPCA under noisy discrete observations, covering diverging eigenfunction indices and increasingly dimensional principal subspaces across sparse-to-dense random designs, together with the intrinsically two-dimensional optimal covariance estimation rates over general bivariate function classes.
